reason: Prioritize the unmeasured recipe that broadens protection to all value/down projections while keeping most weights at 3 bits; it is the clearest memory-focused attempt to recover quality after measured 3-bit and sparse 3/4-bit recipes fell below 95%. Use the second trial on int3-g64 to test whether smaller groups improve quality, with metadata and throughput costs as risks. These are hypotheses only: the evidence does not show that either candidate meets both gates. Then favor other 3-bit protection patterns and group-size variants, followed by measured mixed3-4 and int4. Place 2-bit recipes last because the only measured mixed2-4 result had zero quality, while no evidence supports their quality at target.
